about: ClassBridge Mathematics follows the prescribed syllabus for every class from 6 to 10, chapter for chapter and in the order it is taught. It is written to sit beside the teacher’s own lessons: to explain each idea clearly, to give students worked examples they can follow on their own, and to offer practice at every level.
Ideas are explained before they are used.
Each concept is set out in plain words, with its reason, before a student is asked to apply it, so that what is learnt in class can be revisited at home.
Each worked example is written out one step at a time, with the reason for each step beside it, so that a student can follow the method as well as the answer.
Diagrams are drawn for the page they sit on, beside the question that needs them, so that a relationship can be seen as well as read.

By the Book gives practice for the school examination, in the forms its papers use. Beyond the Book takes the same chapter towards competitive examinations, with solved examples and practice in each of their formats. Neither adds to the syllabus, and Part 1 of this book shows both.
LearnLab, the experiential learning app, offers lessons, interactive simulations and practice for each chapter. A student can explore an idea on screen and then return to the book to work through it.
